evidence.summary: Beihang is one of the Seven Sons of National Defence, the seven universities run directly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, which CSET found supply about three-quarters of the graduates hired by China’s defence-industry state-owned companies. It describes itself as new China’s first aerospace university and says it has developed and launched or flight-tested many types of aircraft and spacecraft.

In a 2023 US guilty plea, US Army flight-control software (CIFER) was exported to Beihang in 2017 without the licence its Entity List listing required; the plea agreement says a Beihang representative proposed making the purchase in the name of a third-party company instead of Beihang. US government filings in the case say Beihang was listed for its involvement in Chinese military rocket and unmanned air vehicle systems.
Beihang reports to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
